nodes.description: Global sum of amount * lockPeriod for all active stakes. Mutated in _beforeTokenTransfer.
Stake[] array holding every stake position (lockPeriod, amount, startTime, lastTransferTime).
Mapping of user address to list of stake ids owned by that user.
Mapping of tokenId (stake id) to current owner address.
Cap on the total working balance that may be minted; enforced in stake.
Minimum YOP amount required to open a stake; checked in stake and set by governance.
Address of the IYOPRewards contract used to compute staking rewards.
Address of the access control manager checked in stake when non-zero.
Governance address gating privileged setters via onlyGovernance.
Owner address used for OpenSea collection admin access.
External stake(uint248,uint8) that validates inputs, records the stake, pulls YOP tokens and mints the receipt NFT.
External unstakeSingle(uint256,address) that unlocks one stake, burns its NFT and transfers YOP to _to.
External unstakeAll(address) that burns all unlocked stakes and transfers the aggregated YOP to _to.
ERC1155 hook performing bookkeeping: updates totalWorkingSupply, ownership mappings and stake records on mint/transfer/burn.
External governance-only setter for the minimum staking amount.
External governance-only setter for the staking limit (working balance cap).
View returning the working balance of a given stake id.
Internal pure helper computing stake.amount * stake.lockPeriod.
Internal view comparing block.timestamp against startTime + lockPeriod * SECONDS_PER_MONTH.
Internal view filtering a stake id list to those that are unlocked, using _isUnlocked.
Internal virtual timestamp provider returning block.timestamp.
Internal helper removing a value from a storage array by shifting and popping.
Caller address supplied by the user, reached through _msgSender() in staking and hook execution.
Block timestamp used for lock period accounting and transfer bookkeeping.
SafeERC20Upgradeable.safeTransferFrom pulling YOP tokens from the caller into the contract in stake.
SafeERC20Upgradeable.safeTransfer sending unlocked YOP tokens to _to in unstakeSingle.
SafeERC20Upgradeable.safeTransfer sending the aggregated YOP tokens to _to in unstakeAll.
Arithmetic mutation of totalWorkingSupply (+= on mint/transfer-in, -= on transfer-out/burn) in _beforeTokenTransfer.
External call to IYOPRewards.calculateStakingRewards(stakeId) made during stake and unstake flows.
User supplied YOP amount to stake in stake(uint248 _amount, uint8 _lockPeriod).
User supplied lock period in months in stake(uint248 _amount, uint8 _lockPeriod).
Stake id argument of unstakeSingle(uint256 _stakeId, address _to).
Recipient address argument of unstakeSingle(uint256 _stakeId, address _to).
Recipient address argument of unstakeAll(address _to).
New minimum staking amount passed to setMinStakeAmount.
New staking limit value passed to setStakingLimit.
Local tokenId = stakes.length computed in stake and used for minting and reward calculation.
Local balance = _workingBalanceOfStake(s) in _beforeTokenTransfer applied to totalWorkingSupply.
Local accumulator toTransfer of unlocked amounts in unstakeAll.

edges.reason: msg.sender provides _amount/_lockPeriod and receives the minted receipt NFT in stake.
msg.sender must own the stake id and is the source of the burned NFT in unstakeSingle.
msg.sender's stakesForAddress list is iterated and burned in unstakeAll.
msg.sender acts as operator/from in the _beforeTokenTransfer hook bookkeeping.
block.timestamp is returned by _getBlockTimestamp, creating timestamp dependency for lock logic.
Timestamp from _getBlockTimestamp determines whether a stake is unlocked in _isUnlocked.
Timestamp is written into stake.lastTransferTime and stake.startTime during hook execution.
_amount flows into balance checks, stake record and ERC20 transfer inside stake.
_lockPeriod flows into validation, working supply math and the stake record in stake.
_stakeId indexes the stakes array and identifies the NFT to burn in unstakeSingle.
_to is the recipient of the unlocked YOP tokens in unstakeSingle.
_to is the recipient of the aggregated unlocked YOP tokens in unstakeAll.
_minAmount is written into the minStakeAmount state variable in setMinStakeAmount.
_limit is written into the stakingLimit state variable in setStakingLimit.
Local tokenId (stakes.length) flows into reward calculation and NFT minting in stake.
Local balance computed from the stake is added/subtracted from totalWorkingSupply in the hook.
Loop accumulator toTransfer sums unlocked stake amounts before a single transfer in unstakeAll.
External ERC20 safeTransferFrom call to the YOP token can hand control to an untrusted token contract during stake.
External call to IYOPRewards.calculateStakingRewards executes before the stake is recorded in stake.
stake pushes the new Stake struct into the stakes array.
stake enforces totalWorkingSupply + amount*lockPeriod <= stakingLimit.
stake requires _amount > minStakeAmount before accepting the stake.
stake queries accessControlManager.hasAccess(msg.sender, this) for permissioned staking.
The ERC1155 _mint inside stake invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
External ERC20 safeTransfer to _to in unstakeSingle can invoke untrusted receiver code.
External IYOPRewards.calculateStakingRewards is called during unstakeSingle.
unstakeSingle requires _isUnlocked, which depends on block.timestamp for the lock period.
The ERC1155 _burn inside unstakeSingle triggers the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
External ERC20 safeTransfer to _to in unstakeAll can hand control to an untrusted token/receiver.
unstakeAll derives the list of stakes to burn from _getUnlockedStakeIds.
The ERC1155 _burnBatch inside unstakeAll invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
_beforeTokenTransfer updates the totalWorkingSupply state variable on every mint/transfer/burn.
Hook performs unchecked-pattern arithmetic mutations of totalWorkingSupply that feed the unsafe operation.
Hook pushes/removes stake ids from stakesForAddress for the involved accounts.
Hook updates the owners mapping with _to or address(0) on burns.
Hook resets lockPeriod, amount and startTime on the stake record when the NFT is burned.
Hook computes the stake working balance via _workingBalanceOfStake before mutating totalWorkingSupply.
Hook calls _removeValue to delete the token id from the previous owner's stake list.
_workingBalanceOfStake multiplies stake.amount by stake.lockPeriod read from the stakes array.
_isUnlocked compares the _getBlockTimestamp result against the stake lock expiry.
_getUnlockedStakeIds filters stake ids using the timestamp-dependent _isUnlocked check.
workingBalanceOfStake reads the stake struct from the stakes array.
workingBalanceOfStake delegates the calculation to _workingBalanceOfStake.
setMinStakeAmount writes _minAmount into minStakeAmount under onlyGovernance.
setMinStakeAmount is gated by the governance state variable through onlyGovernance.
setStakingLimit writes _limit into stakingLimit under onlyGovernance.
setStakingLimit is gated by the governance state variable through onlyGovernance.
_removeValue mutates the stakesForAddress storage array by shifting and popping.

normalization_plan.reason: Function parameter _amount has no independent meaning outside the stake entry point.
Function parameter _lockPeriod only exists as an argument of the stake function.
Parameter _stakeId is only meaningful within the unstakeSingle flow.
Parameter _to is only meaningful within the unstakeSingle flow.
Parameter _to is only meaningful within the unstakeAll flow.
Parameter _minAmount exists solely to configure minStakeAmount via setMinStakeAmount.
Parameter _limit exists solely to configure stakingLimit via setStakingLimit.
Local tokenId is a temporary derived from stakes.length inside stake.
Local balance is a temporary working-balance value computed during hook execution.
Local toTransfer is a temporary accumulator used only in the unstakeAll loop.
